thread:
jen: Quick heads-up — release cut is blocked by staging pipeline-456. Multiple test shards fail with cache restore 504s and then flake. Need decision for the 4pm change window.

matt: Ack. Which step is 504ing? full logs or just mirror restore?

jen: Looks like the deploybot prefetch step hits GCS mirror with 504 intermittently. Then integration tests time out.

ci-runner: [system] build #2023 pipeline-456: restoring cache from gs://redwood-ci/cache/sha-abc123 returned 504 after 3 retries.

leo: Reproduced locally — `gsutil cp` on that object also timed out twice then succeeded. Network flakiness between region and mirror?

sarah: If it's transient, we can wait 30m and retry. But 4pm change window is in 45m. We should decide: hold cut, or pin to last-good image? @matt thoughts? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

matt: Prefer pin to last-good if we can guarantee no data migrations. Quick check: does the last-good image include the new telemetry flag? If not, might break the rollout assumptions.

jen: Last-good is 2023-03-01 build (sha: def456). New telemetry flag is behind a runtime flag so safe.

anya: Small ops note — pinning requires a manual promo in deploybot. If we pin, we should update release notes to mark telemetry as behind flag and schedule a follow-up patch.

leo: Also check model-serving canary — pinning model-worker image will affect performance tests; I ran perf sim against last-good, looks within 3% of target.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] auto-promotion blocked: pipeline-456 failing. Manual promote allowed by admins. Use `/deploy promote --tag sha:def456 --env staging` to promote.

jen: Proposed plan: 1) Manual promote last-good (sha:def456) to unblock PRs and cut. 2) Open follow-up ticket to re-run full pipeline when cache stable. 3) Note in release notes that telemetry flag is behind feature flag and will be toggled later. 4) If cache errors persist after 30m, escalate to cloud infra.

matt: +1 from me. Who will run the manual promote?

sarah: I can run it. Doing a quick smoke after promote.

jen: Thanks. Sarah — please paste smoke logs here. Also tag @oncall if we see more 504s.

sarah: Running promote now:

sarah: ```
$ /deploy promote --tag sha:def456 --env staging
Promote started: deploy-789
Waiting for canary...
Canary passed: latency 120ms, errors 0.1%
Promote complete: staging -> ready
```

sarah: Smoke results: basic e2e flows green, no obvious regressions. Kicking off cut.

ci-runner: [system] manual promote detected: deploy-789 by sarah. Queueing post-promote integration job pipeline-457.

leo: Noted intermittent cache 504s earlier — I opened INC-342 to track cloud mirror flakiness.

jen: Cutting release now. Will update release notes: mention manual pin due to staging cache restore 504s and follow-up re-run planned.

matt: Leave a comment on the PRs referencing INC-342 and a pointer to pipeline logs. Also add a blurb in release notes: "Cut pinned to sha:def456 to unblock change window; full pipeline re-run pending stability of artifact mirror."

anya: I'll add the release-notes blurb and link to INC-342. Adding a note to schedule re-run at 10pm if mirror stabilized.

sarah: Post-cut: we saw one more cache 504 on a non-critical job ~15m after promote, logged with cloud infra. No hits to production user flows.

matt: Good. Closing this thread once release notes updated. Thanks everyone. :tada:
